key_difference: (D) uses the sender class (SignalType::Object) as the completeness-check 'unique' type, which is shared across translation units, so an argument type that is forward-declared in one TU and complete in another can still produce ODR-folded wrong ConnectionTypes instantiations; (B) uses an anonymous-namespace UniqueType per TU and also centralizes the suitability check (decay, rejecting references, pointer-completeness) in qmetatype.h instead of threading a new template parameter through the connect() call sites.
